name: Marble Fountain
long_desc: A grand marble fountain trickles in the center of the room. It puts your soul at ease and gives you a feeling of protection.

name: Welcome Sign
short_desc: a wooden sign with ornate script
long_desc: This wooden sign has interesting writing on it, you should read it.
read_text: Welcome to STAIR Mud! If you have any bug reports, questions, or suggestions, please email hvnstears@hotmail.com.

name: Getting Started Sign
short_desc: a wooden sign with ornate script
long_desc: This sign has details about getting started in STAIR MUD. Perhaps you should read it.
read_text: The sign reads, "The Gods & Goddess of STAIR Mud would like to take a moment to help you acquiant yourself with some of the basic commands. Please head east to partake in the quick refresher."
